title: Project 3 · Find products that never sold
prompt: Return the name of every product that does not appear in any order item, sorted by name.
hints: Which join keeps a product that has no order items?
After a LEFT JOIN, an unsold product has NULL in the item's columns.
LEFT JOIN order_items AS i ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.product_id IS NULL

wrongAnswers.misconception: Looks for products with no stock, which is a different question.
Uses an inner join, which has already removed the products it is looking for.

feedback: A product that has sold must not appear, and a product with no order items must. Check one of each.
